To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the coagulant (PFS) and the coagulated substance (HA) are both polyelectrolytes, which makes the coagulation process complicated.
the complex-formation is the main coagulation mechanism between PFS and HA, and the hydrolytic process of PFS is not necessary for the removal of HA.

the coagulant (PFS) is more effective in removing HA at higher pH values and that the coagulated HA may be removed through the formation of the complexes between the PFS hydrolyzed products and the functional groups on the HA molecules.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the coagulation mechanisms between PFS and HA, and provides a useful method for the study of the coagulation process.
the effect of the pH on the co-agulation mechanism of PFS reacting with HA.
the coagulation mechanisms and kinetics of HA reacting with PFS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the coagulant action of PFS on HA is mainly due to the complex-formation, and the charge-neutralization and adsorption are the minor mechanisms.
the charge-neutralization and the complex-formation are two competitive reactions happened simultaneously between the PFS reacting with HA at low coagulation pH.
the coagulant PFS is able to remove HA through the formation of the complexes between them, and the coagulation efficiency is mainly affected by the complex-formation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the charge-neutralization is the main mechanism of PFS reacting with HA at low pH.
the coagulant PFS reacts with HA to form a complex at pH 4-7.5, and the coagulation is mainly due to the charge-neutralization at lower pH and the complex-formation at higher pH.
PFS is a kind of effective coagulant for HA, but the coagulation process depends strongly on the pH.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the coagulant dosage should be optimized to match with the pH of the water to be treated.
the fluorescence-quench effect can be used as a new approach to study the mechanism of coagulation process.
the coagulant dosage and pH play important roles in the coagulant performance.
